conviction_note: One weak negative on the write-down line (-1.0), cut to -0.4. Two reasons: roughly half the chance the annual report is not lodged inside this one-session window at all (nothing on the ASX fixes the day, only the statutory 30 Sept deadline), and the sealed lean (+1.34, mostly squeeze and run-up terms) points the other way. The name's last two annual reports moved +2.63% and -2.68%, which is about one A$0.005 tick each way.

findings.finding: The FY26 accounts are the first set drawn up with market cap far below book. Net assets were US$203.2m at 31 Dec 2025, when the directors said 'no indicators for impairment' at a share price of A$0.645. Since then CY2026 guidance (400-500k lb) was withdrawn on 22 Jul, the Life-of-Mine plan has been withdrawn since Aug 2025, and market cap is about A$151m. That is a textbook AASB 136 indicator, so the annual report must at least carry a Lance CGU impairment test and may book a write-down. On top of that comes a second-half inventory write-down to net realisable value, following the US$8.4m one in H1 that came from capitalising full production cost onto small volumes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Financial-statement lodgements have barely moved PEN. The half-year that carried the US$8.4m NRV write-down and a going-concern material uncertainty (09/03/2026 17:13) was followed by 0.0% on 10/03/2026. Annual reports went +2.63% (11/09/2024) and -2.68% (30/09/2025). PEN moves on operational news instead: -26.0% on the 22/07/2026 guidance withdrawal, +22.2% on the 31/07/2026 quarterly. No prior PEN impairment of the Lance CGU could be observed.
findings.why_not_priced: The economic content is priced: at about 0.4-0.5x last-reported book the market already values Lance well below its carrying amount, which is why this is capped small. What the price has not had is the accounting event, plus whatever recoverable-amount assumptions the directors must now disclose with no LoM plan (flows, grades, costs). If the market expected an unpleasant disclosure you would see a building short. What the register shows is 1.47%, up only 0.13pp, and a +1.9% five-day tape. No coverage or preview of the FY26 accounts turned up in search.
findings.independence: The withdrawn guidance and missing LoM plan come from a different document: the 22/07/2026 Operational and Production Guidance Update (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260722/pdf/071y794hlm6qhj.pdf). The market-cap side rests on ASIC's short file (share count) and the Yahoo tape. The impairment itself is an inference, and no company statement says a write-down is coming.

outside_window.finding: MU-5 final investment decision. The 22/07/2026 update said 'expects to make a final investment decision ... in September 2026'; the 31/07 quarterly said 'before the end of CY2026'. The company says Horizon 3 (MU-5 and beyond) needs additional funding, and at about US$18m a quarter of combined operating and development burn, the US$47.1m at 17 Jul runs to roughly early 2027. So an FID is likely to come with a raise. It could land with the annual report, but no document dates it to the window. Sized at zero inside the window because the sign depends on the funding terms.

September-quarter 5B and activities report, due by 31 Oct 2026. This is the real test of the stated runway and of the MU-4 header-house flow targets (HH14 375 GPM by end July, HH15 400 GPM by September, HH17 450 GPM by October).
